text:
lina: Heads-up — found a transitive dep vuln in our image-processing lib that can leak ephemeral keys to logs if RBAC is misconfigured. CVE-2026-0912. Need to decide patch window + customer comms timeline.

raj: do we have a verified PoC or exploit in the wild?

lina: we have a PoC on the internal vuln-board (not public). no known public exploit yet. risk = medium->high if you have permissive service accounts.

zoe: for prioritization: Hosted API customers are exposed immediately; Dedicated customers with private networks are lower exposure but high SLA requirements. Enterprise tier needs 30d notice for maintenance unless critical.

alex: rough plan suggestion: staging patch asap -> canary 5% next day -> 25% after 4h -> full after 24h if metrics ok. keep a 2h rollback window per canary.

raj: operational constraints: autoscaler surge will interfere during restarts. we should reserve capacity and schedule outside peak EU/US overlap.

alex: proposed canary routing snippet for runbook:
```
# route 5% traffic to patched fleet
redwood route update --service=image-svc --variant=patch-2026-0912 --weight=5
```

lina: also need to rotate KMS keys used by that service. rotation should be post-patch, not before — otherwise old tokens may still be logged. ops please confirm KMS window.

raj: KMS team ok with rotation window 1h after full rollout. will add key-rotation job and audit hook.

cs-oncall: we need a short customer notice for Hosted customers and a different enterprise advisory. Draft snippets: "We're deploying a security patch addressing CVE-2026-0912 — no evidence of customer data exfiltration. Scheduled maintenance: Tue 02:00 UTC."

zoe: communications: Hosted: 48h notice + post-mortem. Enterprise: 30d advisory + emergency patch clause. If exploit appears, escalate to immediate emergency cadence.

alex: schedule ask: can we push staging tonight (EU off-peak), canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC, full 24h after if green? ops, security, and CS ok?

raj: ok from infra side, will reserve +25% capacity and enable immediate rollback playbook.

lina: security ack. will prepare PoC-free public statement and internal postmortem template.

cs-oncall: CS ack. I'll prep the Hosted short notice and enterprise advisory draft, and coordinate sends with legal.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: staging: 1777778200, canary: 1777864600, full: 1777951000. See /deploys/1777778200 for details.

lina: final checklist before staging:
- ops reserve capacity + rollback tested
- KMS rotation plan ready (post-patch)
- customer notices drafted (hosted + enterprise)
- monitoring alerts for error spike + key leakage indicators

alex: thumbs if green.

lina: :thumbsup: OK moving forward. will post runbook link here when ready.

zoe: adding :rotating_light: escalate if any signs of exfiltration, notify legal & SOC immediately.

raj: putting an oncall page with rollback commands and logs collection steps.

lina: thanks everyone — closing this thread when runbook uploaded.
